passage.quote: Accept commits the prepared content only when given the explicit review identity.

from.quote: The request must provide the identity of the prepared review. A missing or different identity is rejected. A successful result contains the commit identity, whether recovery was performed, and the acceptance duration; the operation requires the branch and repository state supported by the acceptance model.

passage.quote: case 'accept': { const id = option('id'); if (!id) throw new Error('Acceptance needs --id REVIEW_ID.'); done(); output = accept(root, id); break; }

from.quote: The model verifies the base and proposed content against the pinned handoff, checks structural validity, and commits the selected tree while honoring hooks and preserving unrelated staged and working edits. Saved commit and index state permit a retry to finish an interrupted acceptance without creating a duplicate commit.

summary: Acceptance requires the exact prepared review identity and verifies the live proposal before committing its pinned content.
Hooks and recovery follow the acceptance model, preserving unrelated edits and avoiding duplicate commits after interruption.
Unexpected arguments and content drift stop acceptance. Existing checks are reused; the operation never pushes.
